groups.csv: column group: all on the rows per combination and of Pool; the value csv_group on the pooled rows of a group (combination = the group's key), after the rows of every size

columns.cpsat_policy: CP-SAT started from the policy's schedule

decision_table.rule: one row per size, pooled entry and reported budget on the request clock; values: the printed text of the value macro of each column (p89 f2 of the difference from the greedy schedule of the selected run, in percent of it), null without a number; the rule column has a number at the budgets at which the rules have a schedule on every cell of the entry with a rule record (rules_from_s, the last o_rule of these cells); the columns started from the policy's schedule are comparison (ii), on the request clock by the rules of (vi); bold: the column or columns with the lowest printed value of the row over all six columns, none in a row without a number; macro per row and column: the value macro's name with the budget word, ending in Bold, \bfseries or empty; instances, n_instances and combinations_used: the cells each column with a number is a mean over; same_instances: one set of cells for every column with a number, which the full mode requires (it refuses otherwise), except at a size with the table on the common instances, where a row whose columns are each a mean over the cells of their design (by_design) is kept
decision_table.common: results.<size>.decision_common, at a size whose methods have different design instances: the decision table computed on the instances common to every method of the size (the size's instances that are design instances of every arm and of the policy records), the same comparisons (iv), (vii), (vi) and (ii) on the cells of these instances only, each statistic with its own fresh generator; rows as in decision, every row one set of cells (the full mode refuses otherwise); macros: Common after the size word, the value of the mean and the bold markers; iv, vii, vi and ii hold the pooled entries it is computed from

solver_model.rule: valid records of CP-SAT started from the rule schedule, per size, combination and pooled entry (two or more combinations): median, minimum and maximum over the cells of the variables of the initial model (solver_log_head: the first line starting "#Variables:" after the line starting "Initial optimization model", before the next model of the log), build_s, peak_rss_gb and the time of the first row of anytime (the record's clock: from the solver call for a model configuration, from the start of the arm for the neighbourhood search); a record without a value leaves it out and is listed under missing; descriptive statistics, no random number

fields.peak_rss_gb: peak memory of the solve in GB
fields.first_incumbent_s: seconds until the first incumbent, on the record's clock (for a model configuration from the solver call, after the model build)
